description.default: Runs a local OpenAI-compatible gateway for SenseNova Raccoon Work in the container, with a pooled account pool, automatic token refresh, daily check-in, and QR-code / SMS login.
description.zh-CN: 在容器内运行商汤小浣熊（Raccoon Work）的本地 OpenAI 兼容网关，支持账号池轮换、令牌自动续期、每日自动签到，以及扫码与短信登录。

description.default: Local OpenAI-compatible gateway backed by a SenseNova Raccoon account pool.
description.zh-CN: 本机 OpenAI 兼容网关，后端是小浣熊账号池。

description.default: Show the Raccoon gateway run state, actual base URL, API key and account count.
description.zh-CN: 查看小浣熊网关运行状态、实际地址、API Key 与账号数量。

description.default: Run the daily points check-in for all pooled accounts (or the given ids) and report the granted points.
description.zh-CN: 为账号池（或指定账号）执行每日积分签到，返回本次发放的积分。

description.default: Restart the Raccoon gateway service in the container.
description.zh-CN: 重启容器内的小浣熊网关服务。
